subject: Shinyapps give me 'could not find function "source.with.encoding"' after I pushed my app to it

messages.author: fcb48fa0dd6c0fe8
messages.subject: Shinyapps give me 'could not find function "source.with.encoding"' after I pushed my app to it
parts:
Everything was fine in my Rstudio.
I 'm using R on Windows7.

But I can not get it work fine on shinyapps.io.

In global.R I used

``` R
source.with.encoding('qqLogAnalyzer.R', encoding='UTF-8')
```

Then my shinyapps gives  me this
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : could not find function "source.with.encoding" Calls: runApp ... sourceUTF8 -> source -> withVisible -> eval -> eval Execution halted
 
then I changed to

``` R
source(file = 'qqLogAnalyzer.R',encoding = 'UTF-8')
```

the error did not change at all.
How can I avoid this?
